get.summary: Historical Explorer: best single seasons (or one player's, ranked)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First season (inclusive).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last season (inclusive).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Sort stat (catalog historical.metrics, or yearID).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: JSON: 1-200, default 25. CSV: optional, every row when omitted.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-based position of the first row (paging). Ranks stay absolute.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv: the page's CSV export (same columns and rounding) for the same query.

parameters.name: bats
parameters.description: Comma list: L,R,B.

parameters.name: positions
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. SS,2B.

parameters.name: teams
parameters.description: Comma list of catalog historical.filters.teams values.

parameters.name: combine
parameters.description: Combine split-team seasons into one row.

parameters.name: min_ab
parameters.description: Minimum AB. Setting it switches qualification to manual.

parameters.name: qualified
parameters.description: Apply the qualified AB to rate-stat rankings (the app's default).

parameters.name: min_{STAT}
parameters.description: Stat minimums, e.g. min_HR=20, min_OPS=0.8 (R H 2B 3B HR RBI SB BB BA OBP SLG OPS; catalog minimum_columns). The AB minimum is min_ab.

parameters.name: player_id
parameters.description: Only this player's seasons: the same query, rows limited to the player. Without start/end the range is the player's career.

parameters.name: include_below_minimum
parameters.description: With player_id: also return the player's seasons below the minimums (meets_minimum false, rank null), after the ranked ones. Never in CSV.

schema.description: historical_explorer.csv: Year, Player, Bats, Primary Position, Team, R ... OPS

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait. Sent while the data is still loading (error.details.retry_after); absent when the data is missing.

get.summary: Leaderboards: totals over a span, ranked

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First season (inclusive).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last season (inclusive).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Sort stat or 'score'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: JSON: 1-200, default 25. CSV: optional, every row when omitted.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-based position of the first row (paging). Ranks stay absolute.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv: the page's CSV export (same columns and rounding) for the same query.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: Score weights, e.g. HR:1,RBI:1,SB:1 (the default).

parameters.name: min_ab
parameters.description: Minimum AB. Setting it switches qualification to manual.

parameters.name: qualified
parameters.description: Apply the qualified AB to rate-stat rankings (the app's default).

parameters.name: min_{STAT}
parameters.description: Stat minimums, e.g. min_HR=20, min_OPS=0.8 (R H 2B 3B HR RBI SB BB BA OBP SLG OPS; catalog minimum_columns). The AB minimum is min_ab.

schema.description: leaderboards.csv: Player, Bats, R ... OPS, Score (the page exports its Top N: pass limit)

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait. Sent while the data is still loading (error.details.retry_after); absent when the data is missing.

best_season.description: Counting-stat best season, as the page names it.
best_season.title: Best Season

Catalog.description: Product configuration for the controls, so a client never hard-codes it.

metrics.description: Every metric key used anywhere in the API.
metrics.title: Metrics

Catalog.title: Catalog

label.description: The page's column header (also the CSV header).
label.title: Label

field.description: Dotted path into a result row, e.g. 'stats.HR', 'player.name', 'team.season_name'.
field.title: Field

metric.description: Metric key when the column is a stat (see catalog metrics), else null.
metric.title: Metric

values.description: player_id -> value over the shared range.
values.title: Values

leaders.description: player_id(s) leading at displayed precision (ties allowed).
leaders.title: Leaders

headline.description: Who leads where. Never an overall winner without a user-chosen weighting.
headline.title: Headline

message.description: Plain-language, safe to show. Never a traceback or Streamlit text.
message.title: Message

details.description: Structured extras, e.g. candidates. Left out when there are none.
details.title: Details

build.description: Short git commit of the running code, or 'unknown'.
build.title: Build

seasons.description: [first, last] season in the loaded data.
seasons.title: Seasons

columns.description: The page's table columns, in order (SeasonRow fields).
columns.title: Columns

bats.description: Every batting hand (the page starts with all selected).
bats.title: Bats

positions.description: Every season primary position (the page starts with all selected).
positions.title: Positions

minimum_columns.description: Stats accepted as min_{STAT}. The AB minimum is min_ab.
minimum_columns.title: Minimum Columns

LeaderboardAnswer.description: The Leaderboards answer card (u1_answers.leaderboard_answer), without page-control wording.

context.description: What is ranked, e.g. 'Ranked by home runs'.
context.title: Context

LeaderboardAnswer.title: LeaderboardAnswer

columns.description: The page's table columns, in order (LeaderboardRow fields).
columns.title: Columns

limit_bounds.description: [min, max] of the page's Top N control (the API accepts 1–200).
limit_bounds.title: Limit Bounds

minimum_columns.description: Stats accepted as min_{STAT}. The AB minimum is min_ab.
minimum_columns.title: Minimum Columns

LeaderboardResult.description: Leaderboards: totals over a span of seasons, ranked by one stat or the weighted score.

total_rows.description: Players that pass the minimums (before paging).
total_rows.title: Total Rows

offset.description: 0-based position of rows[0] in the full result.
offset.title: Offset

LeaderboardResult.title: LeaderboardResult

label.description: Short column label the app shows (AVG for BA).
label.title: Label

name.description: Plain-language name for sentences and titles, e.g. 'home runs', 'batting average'.
name.title: Name

decimals.description: Display precision the app uses (rates 3, counts 0, score 1).
decimals.title: Decimals

player_id.description: Canonical Lahman playerID. Stable across name changes.
player_id.title: Player Id

label.description: Unique display label; adds the career span when names collide.
label.title: Label

split_mode.description: team: one row per season and team (split seasons stay separate); combined: one row per season.
split_mode.title: Split Mode

applies.description: True when a rate stat is ranked and a minimum AB is in force.
applies.title: Applies

qualified_ab.description: The qualifying AB for the range under the app's rule.
qualified_ab.title: Qualified Ab

text.description: The Streamlit page's caption (Markdown, names its controls). Kept for parity; other surfaces use summary / explanation.
text.title: Text

summary.description: Short plain-text line the page shows as a chip, e.g. 'Qualified hitters · at least 2,349 AB over 2020–2025'. Empty for counting stats.
summary.title: Summary

explanation.description: One or two plain-text sentences on the rule in force (no Markdown, no control names). Null for counting stats.
explanation.title: Explanation

SeasonAnswer.description: The Historical Explorer answer card for these rows (u1_answers.season_answer).

context.description: Year · team · position of the top season.
context.title: Context

tile_metrics.description: Metric keys of the stat tiles, in order. Values are in rows[0].stats.
tile_metrics.title: Tile Metrics

SeasonAnswer.title: SeasonAnswer

SeasonLeadersResult.description: Historical Explorer: best single seasons for a range and stat.

total_rows.description: Rows in the full result before paging (with include_below_minimum, below-minimum seasons are counted too).
total_rows.title: Total Rows

ranked_rows.description: Seasons that pass the filters and minimums (the ranked part of the result).
ranked_rows.title: Ranked Rows

offset.description: 0-based position of rows[0] in the full result.
offset.title: Offset

player_id.description: Set when the result is one player's seasons.
player_id.title: Player Id

headline.description: Same as answer.headline (kept for v1 compatibility).
headline.title: Headline

SeasonLeadersResult.title: SeasonLeadersResult

rank.description: 1-based rank in the full result. Null only for a season below the active minimum (include_below_minimum=true).
rank.title: Rank

meets_minimum.description: False: below the active AB / stat minimums, shown only with include_below_minimum=true, never ranked.
meets_minimum.title: Meets Minimum

team_id.description: Franchise teamID the app normalizes to, e.g. NYY.
team_id.title: Team Id

season_name.description: Historical name for that season, e.g. Indians.
season_name.title: Season Name

league.description: AL / NL / Unknown for that season.
league.title: League

weighting.description: How seasons are weighted (rate stats by playing time).
weighting.title: Weighting
